purpose: Row-level data-quality tags frozen BEFORE any 2026-07-27 outcome is inspected, so the data-valid subset can never be defined after results are known.

reporting_contract.A: ALL 23 frozen rows -- operational pipeline performance. This is the headline. It includes every stale log, every unconfirmed starter and every opener risk, because that is what the pipeline actually emits.
reporting_contract.B: The pre-tagged data_valid_subset_B -- SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS ONLY. Never the headline, never a substitute for A, and its membership is fixed by this file.

subset_B_rule.log_age_days: <= 21  (three weeks ~ 4 missed starts at a 5-day rotation; beyond that the workload profile is effectively a different pitcher)
subset_B_rule.placeholder_contaminated: must be False  (retained though placeholder_affects_EK is False, so the clause is conservative and non-binding for E[K])
subset_B_rule.opener_workload_risk: != HIGH  (E[TBF] mis-projection is the documented failure mode, KPROP-OPENER-2)
subset_B_rule.gs: >= 10  (the D-B low-GS bucket showed mean model-market diff +0.460 vs -0.081)
